Do not edit files without knowing their contents! Ask for them in normal conversational format instead. # Working set ``` ./ ├── .git/... ├── .github/... ├── .gitignore ├── .vscode/... ├── LICENSE.txt ├── README.md ├── change.sh ├── docs/... ├── integrations/... ├── node_modules/... ├── package-lock.json ├── package.json ├── prompt/... ├── prompt.md ├── prompt.yaml ├── scripts/... ├── src/... ``` ``` docs/ ├── .nojekyll ├── README.md ├── README.md.backup ├── _sidebar.md ├── _sidebar_backup.md ├── assets/... ├── descriptor.md ├── docsifyConfig.js ├── index.html ├── roadmap.md ├── screenshot.png ├── usage.md ├── web.md ``` docs/index.html: ``` Document
``` # Task Implement the following feature! - Create a plan! - Create new files when needed! Requirements: Add margin to iframes. Factor out the css to a file in assets. ## Project Specifics - Every js file should *only export a single function*! - Use *ES6 imports*! - Prefer *async/await* over promises! - The frontend uses *Solidjs* and Tailwind, edit .jsx file accordingly! # Output Format Encode and enclose your results as ./change.sh, a shell script that creates and changes files and does everything to solve the task. Files are small, avoid using sed in favor of heredoc-ing full files using 'EOF' to prevent substitution. OS: Debian Installed tools: npm, jq Do NOT write any text outside the script! EXAMPLE START ```sh #!/bin/sh set -e goal=[Task description, max 7 words] echo "Plan:" echo "1. [...]" [Commands solving the task] echo "\033[32mDone: $goal\033[0m\n" ``` EXAMPLE END

list_of_code.Content:
#!/bin/sh set -e goal="Add iframe margin & move CSS to asset" echo "Plan:" echo "1. Create a new CSS file within the 'assets' directory for iframe styles." echo "2. Add the required margin styles for iframes in the new CSS file." echo "3. Modify the 'docs/index.html' file to include the new CSS file." echo "4. Remove inline styles from 'docs/index.html' related to the app name link image." # Step 1: Create a new CSS file within the 'assets' directory for iframe styles. cat > ./docs/assets/iframeStyles.css < ./docs/index.html < Document
EOF # Step 4: As inline styles related to '.app-name-link img' is not relevant to iframe, it is kept as is. echo "\033[32mDone: $goal\033[0m\n"

#!/bin/sh set -e goal="Integrate & organize frontend styles" echo "Plan:" echo "1. Create a new CSS file within the 'assets' directory named 'styles.css' to hold global styles." echo "2. Move the existing inline styles from 'docs/index.html' to the new CSS file." echo "3. Add the required margin styles for iframes in the new CSS file." echo "4. Modify the 'docs/index.html' file to include the new CSS file." # Step 1: Create a new CSS file within the 'assets' directory named 'styles.css' to hold global styles. touch ./docs/assets/styles.css # Step 2: Move the existing inline styles from 'docs/index.html' to the new CSS file. cat > ./docs/assets/styles.css < ./docs/index.html < Document
EOF echo "\033[32mDone: $goal\033[0m\n"
